''See also: [[Handmaidens of Nakothi Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Handmaidens]] of [[Nakothi]] are terrifying, highly intelligent creatures serving the [[Great Elder]] known as the [[Dead Mother]]. Described in classical [[Imperial]] history as nightmare tapestries of flesh, they possess a dread aspect and thin frames. Physically, they are massive, titanic beings that can tower over the tallest trees on an island. Their anatomy is a grotesque fusion of mismatched parts, often featuring a head that appears as a shifting mass of madness and limbs composed of undulating white tentacles and grasping, human-like bony hands. Unlike the mindless [[Children of Nakothi]], who act as drones or specialized workers made from human remains, [[Handmaidens]] possess a cruel intelligence. Historically, they functioned as overseers and managers, supervising the collection of human parts for [[Nakothi]]'s purposes. In combat, they act as leaders or shepherds, directing the swarms of [[Nakothi]]'s children to attack their targets. They are powerful enough to physically tear apart massive structures, such as the roof of a vast [[underground arena]]. While they are formidable enough to resist certain [[Awakened weapons]], they can be destroyed if a specialized blade penetrates their flesh, causing [[Nakothi]]'s own power to turn against them.}}
